note: Token-discipline dimension: for three questions, the tool sequence a disciplined agent should use and a ceiling on the summed structuredContent bytes (measured x 1.5). The runner sums the bytes of the recorded calls and fails on a breach or a different sequence.

1.lever: sec_lookup_privilege with limit:1 (the counts and parent_duties are exact regardless of limit) + sec_find_roles_by_privilege for the role list; never sec_lookup_role per role (15 KB each)

3.lever: sec_compare_roles with list_limit:1 — the shared/only counts are exact; the lists are what cost. Two sec_lookup_role calls would be ~30 KB for the same number

8.lever: sec_search with the modules filter scopes the role list to one model instead of paging every role; sec_stats is a fixed ~7 KB
